sourced.cat.general.desc: Settings that apply to every mode.
sourced.cat.constants.desc: Values used by Quake mode, trimping and sharking.
sourced.cat.halflife.desc: Values used by the three Half-Life presets.
sourced.opt.custom_movement.desc: Turns every movement change in this mod on or off.
sourced.opt.movement_mode.desc: Which movement to run. Trimping and sharking work in all of them.
sourced.opt.trimping.desc: Crouch as you jump to trade horizontal speed for height.
sourced.opt.sharking.desc: Keeps your speed while you skim across the surface of water.
sourced.opt.uncapped_bunnyhop.desc: Removes the soft and hard caps. Quake mode only, the Half-Life presets have their own limits.
sourced.opt.no_jump_cooldown.desc: Removes the delay Minecraft puts between two jumps.
sourced.opt.jump_particles.desc: How many particles a landing spawns. 0 shows none.
sourced.opt.show_speed.desc: Draws your current speed under the crosshair while the jump key is held.
sourced.opt.show_change.desc: Adds the gain or loss since the previous tick under the speed.
sourced.opt.speed_threshold.desc: Speed in m/s below which the readout stays hidden.
sourced.opt.color_gain.desc: Color of the readout while your speed is rising.
sourced.opt.color_loss.desc: Color of the readout while your speed is falling.
sourced.opt.color_steady.desc: Color of the readout while your speed holds.
sourced.opt.quake_soft_cap_threshold.des: Multiple of your walk speed where the soft cap starts.
sourced.opt.quake_hard_cap_threshold.des: Jumping above this multiple of your walk speed sets your speed back down to it.
sourced.opt.quake_acceleration.desc: How fast you gain speed on the ground.
sourced.opt.quake_air_acceleration.desc: How sharply you can turn in the air without losing speed.
sourced.opt.quake_max_air_accel.desc: Most speed a single tick can add in the air.
sourced.opt.quake_soft_cap_degen.desc: Fraction of the speed above the soft cap kept on each jump. 1.0 turns the cap off.
sourced.opt.trimp_multiplier.desc: How much horizontal speed a trimp turns into height.
sourced.opt.surface_tension.desc: How much of your downward speed survives when you drop onto water holding jump. 0 turns it off.
sourced.opt.sharking_friction.desc: Fraction of your speed kept each tick while sharking.
sourced.opt.auto_hop.desc: Keeps bunnyhopping while the jump key is held instead of needing a fresh press.
sourced.opt.forward_boost_enabled.desc: Lets the presets that have a jump forward boost use it. Off removes the boost everywhere.
sourced.opt.boost_ceiling.desc: Speed at which the jump forward boost stops adding anything, as a multiple of the preset's full speed. 0 removes the ceiling.
sourced.opt.soft_cap_threshold.desc: Multiple of your walk speed where the soft speed cap starts.
sourced.opt.soft_cap_keep.desc: Fraction of the speed above the threshold kept on each jump. 1.0 turns the cap off.
sourced.opt.block_ramps.desc: Keeps the speed a block corner would take. Graze one and you slide along it, hit one square on and you ride up over it.
sourced.opt.ramp_lift.desc: How much of a square-on run turns into height when Blocks as ramps fires.
sourced.opt.use_vanilla_speed.desc: Takes your walk target from Minecraft's movement speed, so sprinting, Speed potions and Soul Speed keep working. Off uses the preset's full speed instead.
sourced.opt.vanilla_speed_mult.desc: Scales Minecraft's movement speed into Half-Life units.
sourced.opt.gain_falloff.desc: Makes gaining speed harder the faster you already are. It shrinks what you gain and never takes back speed you already have.
sourced.opt.gain_falloff_curve.desc: How fast the cost grows. Inverse and Exponential never reach zero. Quadratic and Linear reach zero one scale above the onset and stop your gain there.
sourced.opt.gain_falloff_start.desc: Multiple of your walk speed where gains start costing more. Below it nothing changes.
sourced.opt.gain_falloff_scale.desc: How much more speed, as a multiple of your walk speed, counts as one full scale of excess. Sets how fast the curve tightens.
sourced.opt.step_height.desc: How high a step you climb without jumping, in blocks.
sourced.opt.gravity.desc: Downward acceleration, in units per second squared.
sourced.opt.full_speed.desc: The preset's nominal top speed in units per second. It sets the air acceleration rate and the reference for the jump thresholds.
sourced.opt.input_scale.desc: Strength of the movement keys, in units per second.
sourced.opt.ground_acceleration.desc: How fast you reach the target speed on the ground.
sourced.opt.air_acceleration.desc: How fast you steer in the air.
sourced.opt.air_speed_cap.desc: Most speed one command can add sideways in the air, in units per second.
sourced.opt.friction.desc: How fast the ground slows you on ticks with a movement key held.
sourced.opt.edge_friction.desc: Friction multiplier while the ground drops away more than a block just ahead of you. 1.0 turns it off.
sourced.opt.stop_speed.desc: Speed below which ground friction stops scaling down with your speed.
sourced.opt.idle_friction.desc: Friction on ticks with no movement key held. 0 turns it off.
sourced.opt.max_velocity.desc: Ceiling on speed along each axis, in units per second.
sourced.opt.jump_height.desc: Jump impulse in units. Higher values jump higher.
sourced.opt.commands_per_tick.desc: How many movement steps run inside one tick. More steps make steering finer. The count is fixed and does not follow your frame rate.
sourced.opt.hop_clip.desc: On each jump, crops speed above 1.7 times the preset's full speed.
sourced.opt.forward_boost.desc: Adds part of your forward speed to every jump, which is what accelerated back hopping uses.
sourced.opt.additive_jump.desc: The jump adds to your vertical speed instead of replacing it, unless you crouch.
sourced.opt.soft_speed_cap.desc: Above the threshold, only part of the speed above it survives each jump.
